newsitem.title: ARGENTINA: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS RUN IN 15 TRIES.
newsitem.headline: RUGBY UNION-SPRINGBOKS RUN IN 15 TRIES.

text.p: South Africa ran in 15 tries in an awesome display of new age rugby here as they beat Cuyo 89-19 on Tuesday night.
Debutant left wing Breyton Paulse scored four of the tries, and there were two each from scrum half Kevin Putt, fullback Russell Bennett and number eight Schutte Bekker.
Putt went over in the second minute to open the scoring, but it was not until the first quarter had elapsed that the Springbok game plan clicked into top gear.
They then scored five tries in 10 minutes and denied Cuyo possession for long periods at a time to kill the game off as a contest.
Paulse completed a hat trick in just six minutes as the Springbok forwards overpowered Cuyo, leaving huge spaces for the backs to run into.
Unlike their opening match against Rosario last week the dirt trackers captained by Wayne Fyvie did not relax their grip and they ran in a further eight tries in the second half.

But the news was not all good for the tourists as they were forced to use their full complement of substitutes. Hooker Chris Rossouw twisted his ankle in the opening quarter and was replaced by Henry Tromp.
Putt and Dick Muir were brought off for tactical changes in the final quarter, but Theo Oosthuizen (broken nose), Schutte Bekker (twisted ankle) and Krynauw Otto were forced off with injuries.

Otto is thought to be the only serious problem, suffering a suspected fractured jaw from a punch. He was sent for x-rays, but the Springbok management declined to cite the Cuyo player responsible for the punch.
